content:
Apple TV has just released the first trailer for its new series "Prodigies," starring and created by Will Sharpe of "The White Lotus" fame, taking a "non-traditional" approach to the romantic comedy genre.

"Prodigies," starring Will Sharpe and Ayo Edebiri, will premiere on February 10, 2027.

Apple has officially announced its Valentine's Day 2027 programming slot: a brand-new romantic comedy titled "Prodigies."

"Prodigies" will premiere with its first two episodes on February 10, followed by new episodes every Wednesday until March 17.

The series stars Will Sharpe ("The White Lotus") and Ayo Edebiri ("The Bear"), and is created, written, directed, and executive produced by Sharpe himself.

Below is the official synopsis provided by Apple:

The supporting cast is equally impressive, led by John Malkovich, Tobias Menzies, Yumi Asō, Maria Bakalova, and others.

Apple's current slate of original series doesn't include many romantic comedies, but the talent behind "Prodigies" makes it highly anticipated. With February getting closer, I want to know more details.

Are you interested in watching "Prodigies"? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, and is also available through the Apple One bundle subscription.
